comparison.objective: Open one selected knife-disconnect lever while leaving four neighboring levers closed.
comparison.physical_skill: Selective small-lever engagement through an over-center snap without disturbing adjacent controls.
comparison.success_condition: Named lever reaches open angle and remains open; disturbance of other levers is penalized or fails depending on version.
comparison.reason: Tests selective snap-lever actuation, not tool insertion, fastener loosening/relocking, continuous collar adjustment, or response-guided commissioning.
